call_setting_frame_contract.entry: T=entryESP; A=[T+4]; R=[T+8]; K=[T+Ch]; own B=EBP=T-4.
call_setting_frame_contract.first_notification: Save own B, push K, ECX=K, EBP=[B-4], CALL C16870. Admitted notification preserves A/EBP and consumes K.
call_setting_frame_contract.action_entry: After PUSH ESI/PUSH EDI, CALL EAX at C07B35: EAX=A, EBP=R+0Ch, ESP=T-20h. No extra action argument push.
call_setting_frame_contract.after_balanced_action: POP EDI/ESI; EBX=action-return EBP; POP own B into EBP; reload K=[B+10h].
call_setting_frame_contract.second_notification: Save own B; EBP=action-return EBP; ECX=(K==100h?2:K); push ECX; CALL C16870. Stores action-return EAX and EBP with that code, preserving both.
call_setting_frame_contract.ordinary_return: POP own B, entry ECX and EBX; LEAVE; RET0Ch. Preserves entry EBX/ECX/EBP/ESI/EDI; returns action EAX; EDX may carry action changes; final ESP=T+10h.
call_setting_frame_contract.flags: Initial ADD changes flags; post-action CMP ECX,100h supplies flags surviving the final straight-line notification/restoration. No general flags-preservation claim.
call_setting_frame_contract.conditions: Ordinary notifications and balanced action return with required saved stack storage intact. No promise for faults, nonlocal exits or the unopened action epilogue.

notification_register_contract.entry: N=entryESP, EAX=A, EBP=F, EBX=B, ECX=C. One stacked DWORD at N+4 is consumed on return.
notification_register_contract.prefix: PUSH EBX; PUSH ECX; MOV EBX,E16830; JMP C16884. Code comes from ECX, not the stacked word.
notification_register_contract.restore: PUSH EBP,ECX,EAX; POP EAX,ECX,EBP; POP saved entry ECX,EBX; RET4.
notification_register_contract.ordinary_return: EAX/EBP/EBX/ECX preserved; EDX/ESI/EDI untouched; flags preserved; ESP=N+8.
notification_register_contract.not_observed: Destination data contents, mapping, current owner, initialization, debugger ownership or fault recovery are not read/proved. No signature store, locking, validation or callback in the admitted path.

ordinary_stack_equations.point: Before first notification CALL after own-frame/code pushes
At action entry after ESI/EDI saves and CALL
After action return, EDI/ESI restores and own-frame POP

upstream_composition.actual_C069A2_call: Prior 448-byte gate includes pushes 103h, loaded EBX, current map action then C07B10; notifications both 103h, action EBP=that loaded EBX+0Ch.
upstream_composition.conditional_parent_mapping: Prior parents registration R=S-0Ch. If loaded EBX is that actual node, action EBP=S and known receiver/guard/allocation-spill operands align.
upstream_composition.still_open: C069A2 actual SEH-prologue mapping, OS-handler argument convention, prior 26-byte unwind gap and cleanup descendants, original FH3/nested fault semantics.
upstream_composition.action_physical_hold: C86A37 returning free call still ends saved 12-byte action under CALL_RETURN; C86A3C continuation remains unopened/unrepaired. Balanced action return not established for that action.

decision: Accept ordinary CallSettingFrame action-entry EBP=rawsecondargument+12 and actual notification register/stack preservation; upstream SEHprolog/OS argument association, action physical epilogue, faults and NativeFH3 composition remain held.
